Core 3.2.0 (audit clean-up, owner 08.10.2026: every property mapped to ISA-95 or declared outside, setpoints transactional on_change, SMProfile-Machine declares element_id, source_quality on SegmentResponse, quality facet only on readings, the hub by connectionRef) makes it a minor: 4.2.0. Core 5.0.3 = core 5.0.2 whose standard.json keeps the move record of core 5.0.0 as 5.0.1 carried it (_breakingNote, breaking): 5.0.2 had removed it, and a removed key is classified breaking (the .99 dry run 5.0.1 → 5.0.2, 14.10.); same profiles, same standard 6.1.0. _breakingNote: The move record of this core (0.6.0; the move from core 4.1.0 = standard 5.1.0 to core 5.0.0 = standard 6.0.0): every breaking change by name, read by Versions ("Breaking changes:") and the move draft — never derived from the version number.
_additiveNote: What this core adds over the one before it (core 5.0.3 over core 5.0.1; 5.0.2 is the same model), by name: read by Versions and the move draft beside the move record; nothing here needs a reader to follow.

breaking.text: Customer order: status speaks the B2MML RequestState vocabulary (B2MML-Common.xsd RequestState1Type) instead of our own list — offen → Waiting, freigegeben → Released, in_arbeit → Running, fertig → Completed, abgeschlossen → Closed (a source maps storniert → Cancelled); every reader of status (rules, KPIs, flows, consumers) must follow, a source maps its values with valueMap.

additive.text: Work calendar entry: description, published_date, start_date_time, finish_date_time and entry_type declare their valueType MD (master data), as the same B2MML attributes of the work calendar definition entry do (ISA-95 Part 4 cl. 13; UNS audit T1).

Enterprise, Site, Area, WorkCenter and Machine (and its specialisations by inheritance) state isa95.grain: one equipment element at their equipment level (ISA-95 Part 2 cl. 5.5; B2MML-Common.xsd EquipmentLevel1Type), keyed by the one Equipment ID element_id (UNS audit T5).

WorkCalendarDefinitionEntry and ShiftWindow, which name the same ISA-95 object, state isa95.grain: one recurring entry of a work calendar definition, and one shift on one weekday of the plant's weekly shift pattern (ISA-95 Part 4 cl. 13; UNS audit T5).
